title: Car Valet vs Car Detail: What's the Difference?
meta_description: A valet cleans your car; a detail decontaminates, deep cleans and protects it. What each involves, which your car needs, and when the cheaper one will do.
excerpt: A valet cleans your car; a detail goes further, with decontamination, proper interior work and protection. Here's what each involves, and how to tell which one your car actually needs.

keywords: which car valet do I need

faq.q: Is a car detail better than a valet?
faq.a: Not always. A detail does more, including decontamination and protection, but a car that's already clean and protected only needs a careful wash to stay that way.

faq.q: What's the difference between a mini valet and a full valet?
faq.a: The terms vary from business to business, but a mini valet is usually a wash, vacuum and wipe round, while a full valet spends more time on the interior. Check the list of steps rather than the name.

faq.q: How do I know if my car's paint needs decontaminating?
faq.a: After washing, run your fingertips lightly over a panel. If it feels rough, or a light-coloured car has small orange specks, there's bonded contamination that needs chemical decontamination and often a clay bar.
A detail with machine polishing removes most light swirls and water marks, but not all of them. Scratches that have gone through the clear coat need a body shop.
